items.prompt: Fit all the pieces into the outline. You have 1 medium triangle and 1 small triangle.
hints: Start with the biggest outline. It needs the medium triangle.
Match a long straight edge of a piece to an edge of the outline. Tap Turn if the piece points the wrong way.
Tap a piece on the board to pick it up and try it in another place.
items.explanation: The 2 pieces fit together with no gaps: 1 medium triangle and 1 small triangle. Each piece fills one outline exactly.
